headline: Prime angle but knee-to-waist high — glassy dawn log or nothing.
today: The SE lines up prime for Lido, just undersized at 4-6s. Light ENE/WSW dawn and morning keeps it glassy before the SW cross-on kicks in this afternoon. Dawn to mid-morning is your window — bring the log and don't expect much size.

daysToWatch.note: N offshore morning with prime-angle SE around 2ft. Cleanest small day of the stretch, worth an early session.
Onshore builds hard to 19mph SSW by evening. Blown out, don't bother past dawn.
